name: Marketing ramp plan (dormant by ruling, ready by design)
summary: The standing ruling is that dedicated marketing waits until the game picks up speed — so the channel team's job right now is readiness, not reach. Press kit, capture pipeline, channel handles, and a creator list all get built quietly while the game earns its moment; when a public release shows organic pull, the ramp plan fires.
requirements: Press kit current with each public release (screens, GIFs, fact sheet, contact)
Gameplay capture pipeline producing channel-ready clips from real builds
Channel handles secured and minimally alive (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Discord)
Creator list researched and tiered, keys ready to send
A written trigger: the measurable signal that flips marketing from dormant to active
current_status: Planned. The trigger definition is the interesting open question — 'picks up speed' needs a number (wishlist velocity, itch downloads/week, organic mentions) so the ramp decision is a reading, not a feeling. Marketing lead to propose the trigger for CEO sign-off.

plan.step: Propose the activation trigger metric to the CEO
Stand up press kit and capture pipeline
Secure handles; soft-launch channels with dev-log-grade content
On trigger: launch-window campaign across all channels

plan_note: Plan is intentionally incomplete pending the trigger ruling.
